concepts.name: CAA 2019: Scope and Eligibility Criteria
key_dimensions: Six specified religious communities (Hindu, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi, Christian) - exclusion of Muslims
Three specified countries of origin (Pakistan, Afghanistan, Bangladesh) - exclusion of other neighboring countries like Sri Lanka, Myanmar
Cut-off date of December 31, 2014 for entry into India
Reduction of naturalization period from 11 years to 5 years for eligible persons

Religion-based classification and its constitutional validity
Exclusion of certain countries and religious communities - violation of equality principle

concepts.name: Constitutional Provisions: Article 15 and Religious Discrimination

concepts.name: Secularism and CAA: Constitutional Conflict

concepts.name: Exempted Areas: Sixth Schedule and Inner Line Permit Regions
